verification_report.summary: Both lemmas are correct in the stated compact connected Hermitian setting with CLOSED smooth background zeta. The proof was checked sequentially, including the cited definitions and every substantive transition. Closedness supplies local potentials and exact holomorphic changes of weight. The cutoff construction and singular Hörmander estimate yield overlap constants independent of zeta, phi and m; the weight-dependent local upper bound used to force g(x)=0 does not enter those constants. The regularized maximum therefore gives c=(C_B+1)C_chi depending only on the fixed geometry. These local analytic tools agree with [DemCADG](https://www-fourier.univ-grenoble-alpes.fr/~demailly/manuscripts/agbook.pdf). Across the common analytic zero set, adding a local quadratic gives a positive extended current. Its restriction to that set is positive, while smooth forms have zero mass there, so the original smooth lower bound survives unchanged. [DEL00 Proposition 1.2](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0002035) applies with Euclidean Kähler volume and weight m*psi_j/2, proving the ideal identification and one-sided singularity bound. The final coherent-ideal lemma proves analytic type (1,a) under [SGPT's bounded-remainder definition](https://mingchenxia.github.io/Lectures/SGPT_final.pdf). SGPT's introductory qualitative citation is understood with its dyadic indexing m=2^j; the new all-integer conclusion is proved independently. No bounded mass assumption, convergence assertion, or full analytic-type assertion for the Bergman family is used. The prior transcendental_nakamaye_01 results and memory remain unchanged.
